rationale.engineering_allocation: 50um is 5% of the existing 1mm penetration scale; 10um critical-face allocation is 1%; 100um minimum entity scale removes literal mesh-scale slivers and remains below millimetre mechanical features. These are geometric approximation budgets, not relaxed physical success criteria.

protected_features: complete main inward face and major root/taper notches
large rear pocket including floor, sidewalls and root bulkhead
four mount blind recesses and mouths
mount root slot and 0.15mm side channels
protected_void_rule: Never merge across a protected void core: retain every named mouth/passage and its connectivity; boundary displacement limited by the geometric budget, and source clearance corridors eroded by 0.05mm must remain empty. Sub-0.1mm source tessellation/micro-warp seams without independent mechanical meaning may be absorbed, explicitly recorded; named real 0.15mm channels stay open. No whole-pocket or whole-hole hull.

generation.method: One deterministic source- and feature-aware agglomeration from the fixed reference convex cells, replacing accepted adjacent groups with their hull. Same semantic family/source part first; absorb same-family material intersections to avoid duplicate workface ownership. No physical feedback or parameter retries. All error comparisons remain against the frozen source/reference, not the progressively simplified result.
generation.priority: Sub-0.1mm cells first, then maximal deterministic geometry-preserving merges; stable semantic/spatial naming. No fixed entity count target.
generation.conservative_membership: Keep every reference cell inside the runtime union; no arbitrary deletion. Fully absorbed micro entities lose separate runtime identity, not their material.
generation.error_prefilter: Fixed source-surface signed-distance samples and fixed critical-face constraints; geometric budget is the merge criterion. Final error validation may BLOCK the single candidate; do not change budgets after observing results.
generation.internal_faces: List complete closed convex surfaces; artificial partition closures must be within the runtime union. Extract actual union exterior for distance checks, not all internal mesh triangles.
generation.minimum_scale_rule: Every output entity must have inscribed diameter >=0.1mm. Any remaining thin nonsemantic cell that cannot be absorbed within the frozen budgets causes BLOCKED.

validation.surface_metric: Bidirectional signed exterior-surface distance to the frozen reference union; report sampled extrema and conservative triangle-covering bounds separately. Quantify critical regions separately.
validation.topology: Independent frozen-source mouth/axis/pocket/notch clearance witnesses plus boundary error; never substitute a few cube contacts for preservation.
validation.status_rule: FROZEN only if all declared bounds, minimum entity scale and protected mechanical structures are verified. Otherwise BLOCKED with actual generated candidate and explicit failing evidence.
